lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in three loosely defined horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-toned pixels on the dorsal margin and a shadow band on the ventral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin; the distal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots.
